units: <cite ref="Chullin 10b:8">Ḥull. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אוקי אַחֶזְקֵיה</he> (strike out <he>מילתא</he>) place everything on its once ascertained status as long as you have no evidence of a change.
<cite ref="Yevamot 31a:11">Yeb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אַחֶזְקָהּ</he> upon her condition as it would be if there were no evidence at all.
